title: Leadpages Review (2026)
intro: Leadpages is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Leadpages is a conversion-focused landing page, website, and blog platform with AI page creation, A/B testing, Smart Traffic, heatmaps, and lead enrichment. Leadpages Grow/Optimize/Scale start at $99/$199/$399 per month (monthly; ~20% off annual); HTML Pub publishing plans start at $10/mo. 7-day free trial; unlimited traffic on Leadpages plans. Confirm live promotions. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Leadpages when landing-page conversion optimization — A/B testing, Smart Traffic, heatmaps, and lead capture — is the primary job.
verdict: Choose Leadpages when landing-page conversion optimization — A/B testing, Smart Traffic, heatmaps, and lead capture — is the primary job. Compare ClickFunnels or Kartra for funnel/all-in-one creator stacks; Marketo for enterprise B2B MAP; a dedicated ESP if you only need email. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
